title: Making a larger surface
hook: Change new surface area and predict surface energy.
misconception: surface energy stays fixed when new surface area doubles.
objective: Apply E = γA to compare surface energy when new surface area changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a fixed surface tension and a single interface, E = γA. When new surface area doubles, surface energy becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model E = γA; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a fixed surface tension and a single interface, with a nonzero initial result. If new surface area triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on surface energy?
recall.why: Apply E = γA under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
